response.sql:
WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebtotal,
    AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY orderslink
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS mean_order_net_fee_rate
  FROM per_order
),
above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT p.avg_rebtotal, p.avg_net_fee_rate, b.mean_order_net_fee_rate
  FROM per_order AS p
  CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
  WHERE p.avg_net_fee_rate > b.mean_order_net_fee_rate
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_rebtotal) AS average_total_rebate,
  AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS average_net_fee_rate,
  AVG(avg_net_fee_rate - mean_order_net_fee_rate) AS average_excess_net_fee_rate
FROM above_benchmark;

assumptions.assumption: All fee records with NULL orderslink form one group, as with SQL GROUP BY. Each resulting group, including that NULL group, counts once in the benchmark; AVG ignores NULL values, including when feerate - rebrate is NULL.
